newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The State Ownership Fund (FPS) had talks with managers of 17 loss-making companies earmarked for closure.
* The Government will start talks with trade unions on wage indexations and taxes.
* The FPS aceepted on Wednesday five bids for the purchase of 51 percent in local cement maker Romcim.

The FPS will start the negociation with French cement maker Lafarge, British building material RMC Group Plc, German construction group Heidelberg Zement AG, Valenciana de Cementos Portland from Spain and Romania's private company Grivco.
* The Shapiro investment bank of the U.S. acquired 40 percent of Romania's pharmaceutical plant Biofarm.
